dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: How fareth the recall upon the fourth floor?

dataList.title: Maison du Noir
dataList.content: The Footwear Hall has completed its mass recall and begun inspections. The Handbags Hall, however... says it will need a little more time.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Dispatch a few sales associates to the Handbags Hall. Should we tarry much longer, the Rouges shall drive us from the fourth floor as well.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: As for the third floor... Was Two-piece not hired to bar the corridor? Yet our foes have broken through still.

dataList.title: Maison du Noir
dataList.content: There was an incident involving a stranger who assisted the Rouges, but most of the trouble came from those who infiltrated through the Public Address Room route.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: ... This new Voice hath turned the Rouges' ears from the broadcasts. Convey this to the third floor's Floor Manager: I would have them pledge allegiance to Le Noir, and bar those intruders from our stores.

dataList.title: Maison du Noir
dataList.content: Understood.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Hmm. And what tidings of the first floor?
Plans for running each store, plans for taking back the Luxury Hall...
The conversation beside me just kept going, filling my ears with all sorts of rumors that were all equally beyond my league.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: Um... You seem pretty busy. Would it be okay if I went on ahead by myself?

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: I really only came to pass on that rumor from Miss Alterationist. That's all...

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: ... Aye. The Voice hath already revealed that to me.
I'd waited for the season to change so I could make my way down to the first floor, then head for the basement floors...
... only to get stopped by Le Noir's Brand Manager. Now I was stuck tagging along with her.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Yet thou art a Kaki, art thou not? Adrift, with no devotion to the exalted Obsidian God to guide thy path.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Until thou departest this floor, thou shalt remain at my side, where I may keep watch over thee; for I know not the definition of thy justice.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: My definition of... justice?

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: There is naught in the Grand Magasin of which one may be certain.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Once, the names of Le Noir and Le Rouge upheld values of their own. Yet even these were dismantled by those profane souls known as Le Néant.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Even if thou dost take the disorder of Le Kaki as thine order and live by it, the scales upon which chaos balances itself are uneven.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: You mean... like how Miss Alterationist helps the Noirs?
Ever since word got around that the Rouges had a new god...

... people in this department store started caring less and less about keeping up with the latest trends. Instead, they'd pick either Le Rouge or Le Noir, then throw themselves into that brand's fashion—and that brand's alone.
But... that wasn't what I wanted.
Red or black. I'd never be able to make the clothes I had in mind by limiting myself to only one of them.
The two colors might clash in the same outfit. They might not blend well together, but I'd still take the chance and mix them up to make something out of both.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: I just wanna see all sorts of things that exist here—hear about them, try them for myself... and use all that to make beautiful clothes.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Much as thy present attire maketh no distinction between Noir and Rouge?

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: ... Yeah.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: The more thou dost shop, and shop again for all eternity within the Grand Magasin, the finer a designer thou shalt become.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: I... I think so too. I could become a really great one someday.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: And I mean... good enough that even the models on 6F would ask for my brand!

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: You know, I was something of an artist outside.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: ... "Outside"? How distant a word that hath become.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Tell me, what manner of person wert thou in that world?
Walking through a corridor where the sunshine was especially stinging, the Brand Manager asked the question without so much as looking my way.
"Outside." I could barely remember what it'd been like anymore.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: ... A pretty sorry one, I guess.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: All I could ever create out there... were fakes.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: I can offer thee no comforting words, for I have never led so wretched a life myself.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Nor shall I ever know such a life, so long as I heed the Obsidian God's words and abide by the order our Lord hath proclaimed—the one true order of this department store.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: However... I wish thee a better lot here.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: This, uh, "Obsidian God"... What's he like? I've heard his Voice in the Noir stores a few times, but...

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Shh.
As we were heading to the escalator, the Manager suddenly came to a halt before the storefront of Le Rouge Contemporary Hall.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Witness ye in silence,

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: for the Obsidian God to me speaketh.
Just when the Manager closed her eyes and knelt down as though to pray...
... a familiar silhouette came into view, past the dormant wallets littering the corridor.
Last season, I had no idea who he was—but I've had the time to learn more about him since then.
The false god of Le Rouge, their new "Voice."
I didn't realize it then, but back at the Alteration Shop, his appearance was what indicated that the Rouges' assault was imminent.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: Manager...! Open your eyes! They're here...!
And wouldn't you know it—Le Rouge sales associates, wearing pincer-like bracelets, began marching across the corridor toward us...
... but the Manager's eyes remained shut, focused entirely on hearing the Voice.
I cursed under my breath. I really didn't want to use it here, but there wasn't much else I could do... So I swallowed back the tears and brought out the fabric I'd picked up on the third floor.
As my fabric managed to briefly repel the first wave of the Rouges...
The Brand Manager slowly opened her eyes and raised her greathammer, her audience with the Voice concluded.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: I proclaim this land a hallowed sanctum.
I shut my eyes, momentarily stunned by a burst of light. It was unlike the sunshine of this department store, but it was still blinding.
Strange symbols began creeping along my clothes—the parts that were woven from Le Noir fabric, to be specific.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: ... The Obsidian God hath already promised me eternity and preservation.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Thou needst not have stood in my defense. Alas...

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Just what be that... thing?

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: I-it's a Mannequin in my storage.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: I've dressed it up with clothes I designed, what with it being fabric and all...

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: ... I cannot say that thy design is much to my liking, yet the quality is quite adequate.
With each wave of the Manager's hand, brilliant nails of light materialize from thin air.

The way they came into being almost looked as though threads of light were weaving them into existence, each grain falling into an orderly pattern of warps and wefts. And just as I realized every nailpoint was angled toward a different Rouge assailant...
... there was a blur, followed by a powerful gust, as the hammer struck the head of each nail as though drawn by some gravity.
After a veritable storm of nails and hammers reduced the onslaught of Rouges into red paste... the false god could not be seen anywhere.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: ... We must lay siege upon the second floor anon.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Though I had intended to descend to B2F abreast thee, one of Le Kaki...

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: 'tis evident to me that now is the time to rise.

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: Did the Obsidian God tell you to... climb?

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: ... Nay.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Concerning the false god... the Lord has said that...

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: ... Tut, I shan't let doubt taint my lips, for this ordeal be but a test of my faith.

dataList.title: Le Noir Brand Manager
dataList.content: Prithee, let this rumor spread far and wide.
Well, now that I've seen the Brand Manager up the escalator...
... it's time to head downsta—

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: ... Huh, was this always here?

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: "The human forms... converge again and again... upon the structure of a... tree..."

dataList.title: Le Kaki
dataList.content: "Past life." Past life, in a past life, I...
